title.en: Interview about The Witness and related design topics

subtitle.en: Tom McShea of Gamespot interviews Jonathan Blow for the Break Room Interview series.
subtitle.zh: Gamespot 的 Tom McShea 为「Break Room」采访系列采访 Jonathan Blow。

blocks.en: On January 31, 2013, Tom McShea of Gamespot interviewed me as part of their Break Room Interview series. It was an interesting conversation!
blocks.zh: 2013 年 1 月 31 日，Gamespot 的 Tom McShea 在他们「Break Room」采访系列里采访了我。这次谈话很有意思！
[采访在这里。（原文此处有一张图）](http://www.gamespot.com/the-witness/videos/the-break-room-interviews-jonathan-blow-6403321/)
